name: memki
description: Open-source, framework-free implementation of Anki: a precise FSRS-6 / SM-2 spaced-repetition core with full .apkg/.colpkg interop.
author: Phylliida Dev

scripts.build:android: bash scripts/build-capacitor.sh && npx cap sync android

comment: Core (index/fsrs/model/text/ids/sha1) is dependency-free by import graph; only the ./apkg interop module imports sql.js, fflate, and fzstd. Markdown rendering (./markdown, used by ./template and ./apkg export) and HTML→markdown conversion (./html-to-md, used by ./apkg import and the app migration) import vendored single-file builds in vendor/ (marked, highlight.js, turndown, domino) — no npm dependencies at runtime, works offline.
